name: Jimwyl Steve Perez
summary: I work on electronic document and records systems: what is stored, who is using it, and what should have been disposed of years ago. Most of my work turns messy repositories into numbers people can act on.

timeline.detail: Reporting and utilization analysis for the enterprise document and records management system, covering six dashboards from storage growth to retention compliance.
Retention scheduling, metadata standards, and onboarding departments onto a shared classification scheme.
